environment: macOS (darwin 25.6), Python 3.14.7, Node 24.19.0, git; scratch repos from the testkit cli-runner with a scratch HOME, TZ=UTC, PYTHONUTF8=1; baseline skill from git archive main

cases.title: A command without --format prints the config format
cases.given: A scratch git repo with .sdlc/config.json {gitMode: pr, branchFormat: feature/{name}}
cases.when: name, parse, list and preflight run from a scratch cwd without --format
cases.then: Each prints one JSON object with format feature/{name}
cases.expected: exit 0, one JSON object, ok true, format feature/{name}, empty stderr, repo and cwd trees unchanged
cases.actual: All four commands: exit 0, format feature/{name}, stderr empty, trees unchanged

evidence.title: parse without --format
evidence.inline:
$ python3 branches.py parse --repo <scratch>/repo --branch feature/S-1
exit: 0
--- stdout
{"ok": true, "command": "parse", "format": "feature/{name}", "args": {...}}
--- stderr
(empty)

evidence.title: repo and cwd
evidence.inline: unchanged after each run (cli-runner snapshot, git refs included)

cases.title: --format wins over the config format
cases.when: Each command runs with --format sdlc/{name}, with --format=sdlc/{name:lower}, and with --format before the other flags
cases.expected: exit 0 and format sdlc/{name} or sdlc/{name:lower}, never feature/{name}
cases.actual: 9 runs: exit 0, format equals the --format value in each
cases.specSource: R-016 quote (config is the fallback); R-014 acceptance (documented flags)

cases.title: An invalid config format fails without --format, and a valid --format overrides it
cases.given: Config branchFormat in: feature/x, 'a {name}', {name}{name}, x/{name}}, x/{id}, x/{name}+TAB
cases.when: Each command runs without --format, then with --format sdlc/{name}
cases.then: Without --format exit 2 with one {ok:false,error}; with --format exit 0
cases.expected: exit 2, stdout exactly {ok:false,error:<non-empty>}, no traceback; then exit 0
cases.actual: 48 runs as expected. Example: exit 2, {"ok": false, "error": "the branch format 'feature/x' must hold exactly one {name} or {name:lower}, found 0"}
cases.specSource: R-014 quote (exit 2 on bad input); ADR-20261009-024036 (structural checks in S-001)

evidence.title: config feature/x, name without --format
evidence.inline:
$ python3 branches.py name --repo <scratch>/repo --kind slice --id S-1
exit: 2
--- stdout
{"ok": false, "error": "the branch format 'feature/x' must hold exactly one {name} or {name:lower}, found 0"}
--- stderr
(empty)

cases.title: Malformed config JSON fails without --format; with --format the config is not read
cases.given: config.json holds '{not json', a trailing comma object, or a UTF-8 BOM before valid JSON
cases.when: Each command runs without --format, then with --format sdlc/{name}
cases.then: Without --format: exit 2 with one JSON error. With --format: recorded only
cases.expected: exit 2 and one {ok:false,error} for invalid JSON
cases.actual: Invalid JSON: exit 2 with one JSON error. BOM: exit 2 ('Unexpected UTF-8 BOM'), recorded as a seed. With --format: exit 0 for all three files, because load_format is not called
cases.specSource: R-014 quote; spec silent on malformed config with --format (recorded)

evidence.title: malformed config with --format
evidence.inline:
$ python3 branches.py parse --repo <scratch>/repo --branch feature/S-1 --format 'sdlc/{name}'
exit: 0
--- stdout
{"ok": true, "command": "parse", "format": "sdlc/{name}", ...}

cases.title: An empty, missing or non-string config value falls back to sdlc/{name}
cases.given: No config, {}, branchFormat '', null, 7, a list, top-level list, top-level string, and a repo without .sdlc

cases.title: An empty --format is refused, not replaced by the config format
cases.actual: 8 runs: exit 2, error "the branch format '' must hold exactly one {name} or {name:lower}, found 0"

evidence.title: empty --format
evidence.inline:
$ python3 branches.py name --repo <scratch>/repo --kind slice --id S-1 --format ''
exit: 2
--- stdout
{"ok": false, "error": "the branch format '' must hold exactly one {name} or {name:lower}, found 0"}

cases.title: An unreadable config or a directory in its place gives one JSON error
cases.given: config.json is a directory, or a file with mode 000
cases.then: exit 2 with one JSON error, no traceback
cases.actual: 8 runs: exit 2 with 'cannot read ...' JSON error, stderr empty

cases.title: python3 branches.py <command> runs from a scratch cwd under -I, and with spaces and unicode in paths
cases.given: Scratch repo with config feature/{name}; empty PYTHONPATH
cases.when: python3 -I branches.py <cmd> from a scratch cwd; then parse with cwd 'with space é' and repo 'repo ü x'
cases.then: Each prints one JSON object with exit 0
cases.actual: 5 runs: exit 0, one JSON object, format feature/{name}

cases.title: Import by path: no side effect, public functions present, stdlib only, main returns a code
cases.given: A copy of the skill directory, bytecode writing on, open() and subprocess spied
cases.when: A probe under python3 -I from a scratch cwd loads branches.py via spec_from_file_location, parses its imports with ast, and calls main() with 8 argv lists
cases.then: No stdout, no file open, no subprocess at import; Fail subclasses Exception; load_format, validate_format, main callable; all imports in sys.stdlib_module_names; main returns 0 or 2 for every command input
cases.actual: Import stdout empty; no open; no subprocess; Fail is an Exception; all three callable; nonStdlib []; only __pycache__ added. main returns 0 for valid parse and name, 2 for 'name', [], 'bogus' and a bad --format. main(['--help']) and main(['parse','-h']) raise SystemExit(0) after printing usage (spec does not define --help; seed)

cases.title: The module imports and parse runs without git-modes.json and without git
cases.given: A skill copy without git-modes.json; PATH starts with a fake git that records each call
cases.when: Load the module by path and call load_format and validate_format; run parse and preflight
cases.then: Import and parse succeed; git is never called; preflight fails with one JSON error
cases.expected: stdout 'feature/{name} sdlc/{name}'; parse exit 0; preflight exit 2 JSON
cases.actual: As expected; the fake git marker file was never written

cases.title: A decoy branches.py in the cwd does not shadow the real module
cases.given: A scratch cwd that holds a decoy branches.py which records its import and exits 97
cases.when: Each script runs --help from that cwd, and is loaded by path through importlib from that cwd
cases.then: --help exits 0; mod.branches.__file__ is the skill's branches.py; the decoy never runs
cases.actual: All three scripts: exit 0, real path, decoy marker absent. A mutant without the sys.path.insert line fails this case
cases.specSource: R-098 acceptance (import resolves through the script directory)

cases.title: A decoy branches module on PYTHONPATH does not shadow the real module
cases.given: PYTHONPATH names a dir with an exiting decoy, a shadowing decoy, or a branches package that exits 97
cases.then: exit 0, usage printed, decoy never imported

cases.title: Each script runs through a symlink, a relative path and python3 -I
cases.given: A symlink to each script in another directory; a scratch cwd
cases.actual: 9 runs: exit 0. A mutant without the sys.path.insert line fails the -I run
cases.specSource: R-098 acceptance (runs with the cwd outside the skill directory)

seeds.title: branches.py --help and -h exit through SystemExit in main()
seeds.detail: main(['--help']) and main(['parse','-h']) print argparse usage text on stdout and raise SystemExit(0). An in-process caller of main() gets an exception instead of a return code, and the CLI prints usage text, not one JSON object. The spec does not define --help, so this does not refute.

seeds.title: A UTF-8 BOM in .sdlc/config.json makes every command without --format exit 2
seeds.detail: load_format opens config.json with encoding utf-8, so a BOM gives 'Unexpected UTF-8 BOM'. Some Windows editors write a BOM. utf-8-sig would accept it. The spec does not name this case.

seeds.title: A valid --format hides a malformed config.json
seeds.detail: With --format given, load_format is not called, so a command exits 0 while config.json is invalid JSON. Later slices that read other config keys may need to read the config anyway.

seeds.title: A decoy branches.py beside a symlink to a script shadows the real module
seeds.detail: The scripts insert os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)) into sys.path. abspath does not resolve symlinks, so when janitor.py runs through a symlink in a directory that also holds branches.py, that file is imported (manual probe: exit 97 from the decoy). os.path.realpath would close this. The spec names no symlink case.
